description: After claiming a task from an issue comment or PR conversation comment, fetch fresh context: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number} (title, body, labels, state, author), GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/comments (all comments, paginated). For PR conversation: additionally fetch GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number} (base/head refs) and GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number}/reviews. Truncate at 200 comments with a note in the context.
title: GitHub context hydration — issue and PR conversation comments
